newsitem.title: CHINA: ATHLETICS-CHINA UNVEILS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS TEAM.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-CHINA UNVEILS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS TEAM.

text.p: China on Tuesday unveiled the 27-member team it will send to the World Athletics Championships, saying its medal hopes focused on three or four events.

With Olympic champion Wang Junxia absent from the team due to health problems, China's highest hopes were for a silver or bronze from Huang Zhihong, former Olympic and world women's shotput winner, the Xinhua news agency said.
Other medal hopefuls included Gao Hongmiao, last year's gold medallist in the World Cup women's 10-km walk, and Ren Xiujuan, who currently ranks 9th in the women's triple jump, it said.
The Chinese team features both veterans and newcomers in preparation for the 1998 Bangkok Asian Games and the 2000 Sydney Olympics, it quoted sports officials as saying.

The men would compete in the 110-metres hurdles, the long jump, triple jump, discus, 20-km and 50-km walk while the women would compete in the 100-metres, 200-metres, 4x100-metres relay, 5,000-metres, 10,000-metres, 10-km walk, triple jump, shot put and discus, it said.
The delegation would leave for Athens on July 27, it said.
